questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: I have always wanted to try to study in the US and try that form of college experience. I have also found the culture and the academic life in the US something very fascinating and exciting.

questions.answer: It was a bit confusing to find the information on UCSD's website.

questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: I found it through my friend that I lived with. He found it through his friends. But it is not that hard to find something to live in.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: It is very expensive and there will be a commute

Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: We got a mail on our UCSD mails with the link to registration.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: there is an office for exchange students but I did not use it

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I was very succesfull but that was because of the help of my danish roommates

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Do it in good time in order to get a spot at the classes you want to study.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: The level of the courses were not that high and I found the midterms and finals quite easy but it was still very eventful and I learned a lot.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: I never had midterms or any TA's at my study at UCPH and there is more an opportunity to get to know your professors at a personal level with office hours.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Communication:Conflict of Israel and Palestine
Communication:American News Media 
Philosophy: Law and Society 
Communication: Institutions and Power
Communication: Intermidiate topics in Communication
POLISCI: Power and Justice

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: I would definitely recommend Communication:Conflict of Israel and Palestine because it is very insightful and the Professor is so brilliant.

Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: There were a gym, tennis and other forms of sport

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: try surfing and also going on roadtrips

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: I would recommend to visit downtown San Diego, Coronado Island and also going out of the city

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: It was very easy for me

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Do not be scared to raise your hand in class and to talk to people before or after the classes.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: I did not find any

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: I loved how open people were

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Live off campus so you can see more of the city
don't be scared to talk to people and especially americans 
be prepared for how expensive San Diego is

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: There is a lot of walking also if you have a car. The campus is very big

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: The friends that I got, and That I had the opportunity to live right at the beach

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: being so far away from the friends and family in Denmark, and that UCSD has a quarter system

questions.answer: Yes
